children: Overview
China commercial property lessor's interim revenue fell 8% on weak office and retail demand
Net loss attributable to owners narrowed to RMB34 mln from RMB92 mln a year earlier
Company highlights material uncertainties about ability to continue as going concern due to liquidity pressures
Outlook
Company expects continued challenges in office leasing market in second half of 2026
Company anticipates gradual market stabilization as macroeconomic policies take effect
SOHO China to maintain prudent business strategy and focus on operational efficiency
Result Drivers
WEAK LEASING DEMAND – Revenue fell 8% to RMB638 mln, mainly due to weak office and retail leasing-market demand
OCCUPANCY STABILIZATION - Co said average occupancy rate stabilized at 83% after securing new leases with high-quality tenants
TAX-EXPENSE SWING – Income tax swung to an RMB46 mln expense from an RMB0.5 mln credit, weighing on result
NARROWER PROPERTY REVALUATION LOSS – Investment-property fair-value losses narrowed to RMB25.4 mln from RMB144 mln
